g.text: Complex confidence after design with target context
Each point is one design, averaged over four ESMFold2 critics and two fold seeds. Native references use the same eight refolds.
Pose criterion: target-aligned binder C-alpha RMSD <= 5 A and binder ipTM >= 0.5. Black bars are means across designs.
